City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 25, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 6/11/14 Special Meeting and the 6/11/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-06-25 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-06-25 Item 8B - Warrants List
8C.
Construction contract for the Encinitas Boulevard Safe Routes to School Improvements, CS13E. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Villa
1) Award contract to New Century Construction for the construction of Encinitas Boulevard Safe Routes to School Improvements in the amount of $457,058.50 plus 10% contingency; 2) Authorize the appropriation of $227,255 in Traffic Mitigation Funds to supplement the project budget, and an additional appropriation of $65,500 in Traffic Mitigation Funds to replace the TransNet Funds as local match on this project, for a total appropriation of $292,755 in Traffic Mitigation Funds; and 3) Authorize overall expenditures for the project not to exceed $663,855.
2014-06-25 Item 8C - Award Contract for Encinitas Blvd. Safe Routes to School
8D.
Second amendment to the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (NPDES) San Diego Regional Stormwater Copermittees Memorandum of Understanding (MOU.) Contact Person: Stormwater Program Manager Steenblock
Adopt Resolution 2014-47 regarding the Second Amendment to the National Pollutant Discharge Elimination System San Diego Regional Stormwater Copermittees Memorandum of Understanding, and authorizing the City Manager to execute the agreement.
2014-06-25 Item 8D - 2nd Amendment to the SD Region Stormwater Copermittees Regional MOU
8E.
Adoption of Resolution 2014-50 designating City Manager Vina to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate at the League of California Cities Annual Conference in September 2014. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2014-50 designating City Manager Vina to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate at the League of California Cities Annual Conference in September 2014.
2014-06-25 Item 8E - LOCC Voting Delegates
8F.
Award of construction contract for the Santa Fe Drive North Sidewalk Improvements Project, CS07B. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Approve a contract with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $465,904.00 for the construction of the Santa Fe Dr. North Sidewalk Improvements project, a HSIP project; 2) Authorize augmentation of the existing contract with Excel Landscape, Inc. in the amount of $90,000.00 for landscape and irrigation improvements; and 3) Authorize the City Manager or his designee to award contracts for construction specialists, inspections, and other contracts, including construction staking, traffic engineering and inspection, geotechnical services, materials testing, purchase of landscape materials, engineering inspection, construction of those project elements not covered by the HSIP grant, and contingencies as necessary to complete the project, with a total not-to-exceed cost for the project of $835,043.00.
2014-06-25 Item 8F - Award of Contract for Santa Fe Dr. Sidewalk Project
8G.
Award of construction contract for the Santa Fe Drive Undergrounding District 17 Project, CS07B. Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Approve a contract with Blue Pacific Engineering and Construction in the amount of $914,277.90 for the construction of the Santa Fe Dr. Undergrounding District 17 project, a HSIP project; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or his designee to award contracts for construction specialists, inspections, and other contracts, including construction staking, geotechnical services, materials testing, engineering inspection, and contingencies as necessary to complete the project, with a total not-to-exceed construction cost for the project of $1,200,000.00.
2014-06-25 Item 8G - Award of Contract for Santa Fe Dr. Undergrounding Project
8H.
Cardiff Sanitary Division (CSD) and Encinitas Sanitary Division (ESD) Capital Improvement Program for FY 2014-15 and FY 2015-16. Contact Person: Public Works Management Analyst Wilson
Adopt Resolution 2014-51 establishing the FY 2014-15 and FY 2015-16 Capital Improvement Program for the Cardiff Sanitary Division and Encinitas Sanitary Division.
2014-06-25 Item 8H - CSD and ESD Capital Improvement Program
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the 2014-15 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District. Contact Person: Management Analyst Ruess
1) Conduct a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the FY 2014/15 Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District Annual Engineer's Report; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014-23, Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California Renewing the Encinitas Landscape and Lighting District (Zones A, B, C, D, E, F, G & H), Confirming the 2014-15 Engineer's Report and ordering the transmission of charges to the County Auditor for collection.
2014-06-25 Item 10A - ELLD Annual Engineer's Report
10B.
Senior Citizen Commission Work Plans for FY 2013-14 and 2014-15. Contact Person: Recreation Superintendent Gorham
1) Receive an oral report regarding the FY 2013-14 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan by Lee Vance, Chair; and 2) Approval of the proposed FY 2014-2015 Senior Citizen Commission Work Plan.
2014-06-25 Item 10B - Senior Citizen Commission 2013-2014 Work Plans
10C.
Environmental Commission FY 2013-2014 Work Plan Update and proposed FY 2014-15 Work Plan. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
1) Receive the report regarding the Environmental Commission FY 2013-14 Work Plan Update; and 2) Approval of the proposed FY 2014-2015 Environmental Commission Work Plan.
2014-06-25 Item 10C - Environmental Commission 2013-2014 Work Plan
10D.
Commission for the Arts FY2013-14 Work Plan and Proposed FY2014-15 Work Plan. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
1) Receive Commission for the Arts Work Plan FY2013-14; and 2) Council approve Commission for the Arts Proposed Work Plan FY2014-15.
2014-06-25 Item 10D - Commission for the Arts Work Plan
10E.
Update on draft single-use disposable bag reduction ordinance and environmental review process. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
Receive information and provide any desired direction.
2014-06-25 Item 10E - Disposable Bag Reduction Ordinance Update
10F.
Environmental Commission's report and recommendation on polystyrene food service ware. Contact Person: Deputy City Manager Phillips
1) Receive the Environmental Commission's report; and 2) Provide any desired direction.
2014-06-25 Item 10F - Polystyrene Food Service Ware
10G.
Approval of two proposed major special events in 2015. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
Approve two proposed Major Special Events scheduled for February 2015.
2014-06-25 Item 10G - Major Special Events Approval
10H.
Encinitas Transit Feasibility Study Update. Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong
Receive the informational report regarding the Encinitas Transit Feasibility Study.
2014-06-25 Item 10H - Transit Feasibility Study
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM There are no Council Member initiated Items.
13.

CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
